findings.reason: nova carries no reckon dependency (no reckon entry in pyproject.toml), so the grammar cannot be imported and must be re-encoded, and §1 already documents both roots inline; only a citation of the owning file is missing, which changes wording rather than design.
findings.text: the plan's matcher encodes the worktree layout (`.reckon-worktrees` under the repository parent at line 463, and the legacy `tempfile.gettempdir()/"reckon-worktrees"` at line 470) whose owner is reckon, but §1 and §2 justify the grammar only against nova files (`repository_relative`, the `filepath` click group, the launchers); if reckon changes its root or layout, the nova matcher drifts silently

findings.reason: the section must scope the no-collateral/same-line-endings promise to single-line spans, or drop the wrapped spelling to the "left unmapped and reported" path it already defines, before the implementer can honour both at once.
findings.text: §2 requires the matcher to cover "a single path split across two lines by a log's line wrap" while the same section promises "changes nothing outside the matched spans: the same bytes elsewhere, the same line endings"; a span that contains a log's newline cannot be rewritten to a bare repository-relative path without changing that line ending, so the two statements cannot both hold for that spelling, and any JSON string whose path is re-wrapped risks the still-parses guarantee

findings.reason: the plan's own retire-accounting should name these helpers for deletion with the tests, so the guard has one owner and no orphaned scaffolding.
findings.text: §4 deletes `test_no_receipt_directory_json_records_a_worktree_path` (line 73) and its positive control `test_the_scan_reaches_every_receipt` (line 57), but `_scanned_json` (line 50) and `RECEIPT_DIRECTORIES` (line 45) exist only to serve those two tests and are left behind as a directory-limited scanner beside the new repo-wide guard; a later reader sees a live scan that no longer runs

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the single entry point must cover a worktree path split across two lines by a log's line wrap, a case its own "the same line endings" contract cannot satisfy.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §4 supersedes two tests in tests/test_render_receipt_paths.py but leaves their receipt-directory scanner in place as a second, now dead, owner of the scanning responsibility.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 accounts for its added function, two constants and subcommand and states why nothing in the refusal family retires, and §4 names the two tests it supersedes.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the matcher proposed for nova/database/filepath.py re-encodes the worktree-root layout that reckon owns at reckon/crew/routing.py:463, and the plan cites only nova mechanisms for that grammar.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the one subcommand and the two-line hook are the only wrappers; the hook is necessarily a shim and §4 routes later read-only checks through it rather than adding a second mechanism.
